issues.extracted: Taxes 864,071 split into property tax 820,926 / motor vehicle tax 43,145
issues.on_page: Taxes 864,071 (one line); p2 Statement of Activities prints Property 820,926 and Motor vehicle 43,145 for all governmental funds
issues.issue: The split uses the government-wide breakdown, not one printed for the General Fund line. It ties exactly because only the General Fund has non-lodging taxes, so it is defensible, but the schedule itself doesn't print the split.

issues.on_page: Charges for Services 43,183 (general government 16,080, public safety 21,976, public works 75, public assistance 5,052)
issues.issue: The general government charges are probably county officers' fees (Fees of Office). The report doesn't break them out, so the broad category is defensible.

issues.extracted: per-fund lines for 7 of 8 non-major funds
issues.on_page: 8 fund columns plus Total Non-Major Funds (receipts 131,688, disbursements 133,793)
issues.issue: The rule says a combining schedule with more than 6 funds uses its Total column (fund = 'Nonmajor funds (combined)'). The per-fund lines tie to the Total column (Road Equipment is all zero), so nothing is lost, but this departs from the rule.
